stories.summary: When the U.S.-Iran war began, more than 1,000 dependents of U.S. Navy personnel in Bahrain were ordered to evacuate. After six months in temporary conditions, they want to know what the plan is.

stories.title: Jeffries-Kushner meeting sparks speculation amid contentious US midterms
stories.summary: Private meeting between Jeffries and Kushner fuels discussions amid contentious US midterm battle. United States House Democratic Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries has met privately with Jared Kushner, US President Trump’s son-in-law and a top outside adviser, in a signal that the White House is seeking ways to work with Democrats if they wrestle majority control from Republicans in the midterm elections. Little is known about the details of the discussion, which was first reported on Sunday by the New York Times. The newspaper described it as a high-profile meeting with the hope of sparking bipartisan “common ground.” The meeting reportedly touched on issues ranging from housing and immigration to the cost-of-living crisis. Americans are struggling under inflationary prices that Democrats fault Republicans and Trump for failing to curb. In a statement reported on Sunday, Jeffries did not mention the private conversation but said the Republican administration needed to drop the GOP’s “my-way-or-the-highway” approach that has thus far “failed the American people”. “To stop the madness, we have repeatedly made clear that an extremist approach will not work and will be met with forceful opposition”, the New York congressman said. “The question is whether Republicans will join us.” Kushner also suggested that Jeffries meet with White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles as a follow-up. The reported meeting comes in the final stretch of the contentious November midterm elections in which Democrats may have a chance to win back the House majority, a highly anticipated development that would elevate Jeffries to the powerful Speaker of the House role. If they win back the seat, Democrats are expected to use their oversight power to aggressively probe the Trump administration, including allegations of self-enrichment by the president and his family.

stories.title: US ready to help facilitate Russia-Ukraine talks — deputy envoy to UN
stories.summary: UNITED NATIONS, August 25. The United States is ready to play a constructive role in facilitating talks between Moscow and Kiev aimed at ending the conflict, US Deputy Permanent Representative to the United Nations Dan Negrea said. "The United States will play whatever constructive role it can to facilitate talks between Moscow and Kiev to achieve this outcome," Negrea said. He also called on Russia and Ukraine to return to the negotiating table. According to the diplomat, the parties must halt strikes targeting civilian vessels or putting them at risk of damage.

stories.title: This scientist uses light to perform smarter, cleaner chemistry
stories.summary: To create the molecules we need to help us grow food or make fuel, we rely on chemical reactions — and lots of energy. One scientist may have a "brighter" approach, controlling chemistry with light.
